finding: A single keyless initialize to the Microsoft Learn MCP Server answered 200 on 2026-09-30, reporting serverInfo Microsoft Learn MCP Server 1.0.0 at protocol version 2025-06-18, so the vendor's "no authentication required" holds for the handshake. Two things no vendor page states are visible in this one response. The mcp-session-id it issues is NOT opaque: it is 224 characters of plain base64, no signature segment, of a JSON object carrying the two clientInfo values the caller supplied (name and version), padded by the server with title, icons and websiteUrl as nulls, plus a server-minted UUID in a field named userIdClaim. An agent's client name and version therefore travel inside a header value every intermediary can read. And the response carries no ratelimit, quota or retry-after header of any kind, so a caller gets no in-band signal of any budget. Whether userIdClaim persists is a cross-request question and is answered in this entry's profile, not here.
